summary: User discovered HIGH and CRITICAL CVEs in transitive Go dependencies (grpc, golang.org/x/net, golang.org/x/crypto, markdown) in Temporal Server v1.31.0 via AWS Inspector vulnerability scanning and requested a patch release. Temporal team released v1.31.1 addressing all reported CVEs.
userImpact: Users running Temporal Server v1.31.0 face exposure to HIGH and CRITICAL security vulnerabilities in transitive dependencies that could be exploited.
rootCause: v1.31.0 was released with outdated versions of critical Go dependencies (grpc, golang.org/x/net, golang.org/x/crypto, markdown) containing known CVEs.
proposedFix: Release patch version v1.31.1 with updated go.mod dependencies to remediate the CVEs.
resolutionDetails: Temporal team released v1.31.1 shortly after the report, updating all affected transitive dependencies to clear the identified CVEs.
keyQuote: Thanks for flagging the CVEs. Good timing, we released v1.31.1 clearing the CVEs.
